units.title: Migrate product detail lookup
doneWhen: The legacy HTTP and error behavior is documented
Rust tests cover successful and missing product lookup
The implementation uses a local persistence boundary
All available Java and Rust verification passes
legacy/commerce remains unchanged
notes: Axum serves the detail route through a local repository boundary; focused HTTP tests cover success, missing product, and invalid UUID. Durable storage is deferred to a later migration unit.

units.title: Migrate seller product list
doneWhen: Seller header, pagination, sorting, response envelope, and errors are documented
Rust tests cover list and empty results
The local repository applies the seller filter and legacy ordering
All available Java and Rust verification passes
legacy/commerce remains unchanged
notes: Axum serves the seller list from the local repository boundary. Focused tests cover seller filtering, createdAt ordering in both directions, page slicing and metadata, empty results, and member/paging errors.

units.title: Replace product and group-purchase image APIs
doneWhen: The legacy HTTP contracts are documented
Image bytes and metadata are stored through a database repository boundary
Product and group-purchase namespaces are covered by focused tests
No AWS credential or production S3 integration is added
All available Java and Rust verification passes
legacy/commerce remains unchanged
notes: AWS S3 is replaced by a PostgreSQL-backed local image repository. Product and group-purchase presigned PUT, multipart upload, local read, and idempotent owned deletion are covered by focused tests; Rust gates, legacy testClasses, and the legacy-clean check pass. No live PostgreSQL integration test was available.

units.title: Migrate product create, update, and delete
doneWhen: Create, update, and delete HTTP contracts are documented
Validation, ownership, stock changes, and soft deletion are covered
Repository writes are isolated behind the product persistence boundary
Focused tests cover success, authorization, validation, and missing products
All available Java and Rust verification passes
legacy/commerce remains unchanged
notes: The local product repository now provides atomic create/idempotency, update, hard delete, and soft delete boundaries. Focused HTTP tests cover validation, stock replacement, ownership, missing products, active group-purchase conflicts, and both deletion paths. Product events are deferred to event-boundaries.

units.title: Migrate seller balance and history
doneWhen: Create, current balance, and history HTTP contracts are documented
Member scoping, pagination, ordering, uniqueness, and missing seller behavior are covered
Seller balance data uses a PostgreSQL repository boundary
All available Java and Rust verification passes
legacy/commerce remains unchanged
notes: Internal create, member-scoped current balance and history, paging, allowlisted sorting, uniqueness, missing-seller behavior, and PostgreSQL persistence are implemented. Rust gates, the three relevant legacy tests, and legacy-clean pass. No live PostgreSQL integration test was run.
